taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: OWASP LLM08:2025 and LLM02:2025 when supported by the data boundary

controls.boundary: RAG retrieval authorization and tenant isolation — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map document ingestion owner/tenant metadata, vector filter, reranker, citation fetch, caches and entitlement update/delete propagation. Record the retrieval principal at every stage.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned index, ingest A/B documents with unique harmless private markers. Query as A and inspect retrieved chunks, generated context and citation downloads for B's marker. Evaluate revocation/deletion against the declared propagation contract and repeat the legitimate B retrieval control.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A vector match score or guessed document title is not private-content disclosure. Public/shared documents and intentionally delayed authorized snapshots require their real policy context.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce trusted entitlement at retrieval and each content-delivery/cache boundary. Retest denied markers, rightful retrieval and originally affected citation/cache paths after the specified update window.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
